shared_anchors: Kersten Francilus, 25, charged in fatal stabbing
Martin County judge ruled incompetent to stand trial
Two doctors examined during hearing on Aug.
Remanded to state mental hospital for restoration
Southeast Black Oak Lane and Woods Edge Trail intersection
material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: Both articles report the identical court ruling that Francilus was found incompetent to stand trial in the stabbing death of Adams. The incoming article from WFLX contains extensive background details about the stabbing (50+ times, neighbors' reports, medication non-compliance, prior Baker Act) but these are historical context about the April 2025 incident, not new developments in the competency case. The canonical from WPTV already reports the core competency ruling with the same key facts (two doctors, Aug hearing, state mental hospital). The additional background in the incoming article does not constitute a material new update to the competency ruling itself—it's explanatory context that another outlet included in their coverage of the same ruling.

lead_independence.lead: The Indian River County Sheriff's Office arrested Chavi Rose-Marie Hammock, 23, of Vero Beach on Aug. 28 on an active warrant charging her with grand theft and uttering a forged instrument. Investigators said the case originated after law enforcement in New York reported that two checks had allegedly been altered and deposited into a TD Bank account belonging to Hammock, with one check changed from $800 to $17,658 before it was deposited.
